description: Opus W unit 7, the Update pass order: Clefable and its Symbiosis ally Oranguru tie at 80 Speed, both below half HP with a Sitrus Berry (patched). At the turn-start Update, Showdown shuffles the tie: if Clefable eats first, Oranguru passes its Sitrus to it (Clefable eats that one after the first action; Oranguru heals nothing); if Oranguru eats first, both heal once. 1/2 each.
